name: Construction unit conversions
summary: Convert length, area, or volume between mm, m, ft, in, m², ft², m³, and yd³.
author: friday-core
description: Uses fixed factors (1 in = 25.4 mm, 1 ft = 0.3048 m, 1 yd³ = 0.764555 m³). This is a planning aid, not a substitute for a licensed engineer's calculations or sign-off, and it is not professional certification.
